hero.name: Sanghyeon Shin
hero.lead:
An IT planner who defines problems with data,
then builds and ships.
hero.summary: As a Community Manager Intern at LIKELION, I helped run a 2,000+ participant hackathon across 80 universities — co-designing the judging policy and building three ops tools with AI that went live on site.

about.description_1: I worked as a Community Manager Intern on LIKELION's Univ. Team 1 (Apr – Aug 2026), running a university community of ~2,500 members across 80 schools. For the 14th national hackathon I co-designed the judging policy and platform feature specs with the team and built three ops tools myself. I also planned and taught a six-session dev literacy course for non-developer colleagues.
about.description_2: I studied Global Business & Technology alongside an AI Convergence major, and through LIKELION staff roles, hackathons, and startup programs I've planned and built 15+ services, winning 11 awards. I completed SSAFY's 15th Java track.
about.what_sub: I define problems in numbers, resolve colliding interests with policy, and build the tools that don't exist yet.

items.d: 562 repos, 53% in a survey, a 41.6%p usage gap. Every plan starts from a number that can be checked.
A 100-point rubric, graded violation verdicts, a 5-level permission matrix. Where interests collide, I design the rule.
A submission checker, a finals console, an FAQ bot. When a tool doesn't exist, I build it and ship it.
